Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0105 1. Lemma 3.32\group harmonic-coordinates

In harmonic coordinates, the Ricci tensor satisfies \[ -2R_{ij}=\Delta (g_{ij})+Q_{ij}(g^{-1},\partial g), \] where $Q$ is quadratic in $g^{-1}$ and $\partial g$.
